title: What If You Were Invisible to Everyone Except Your Crush?
description:
One morning Gus wakes up and nobody can see him. Not his mom, not his brother, not the teacher taking attendance. He walks through school like a ghost. Then Lia, the girl with the pink bow, looks straight at him and says "hi."

For one week, he's invisible to the entire world except the one person he never had the courage to talk to.

Gus doesn't talk much. He wears orange headphones, eats the same cheese sandwich every day, and keeps ending up inside the weirdest "what if" situations in town.

Would you use the week to get close to her, or to find out why it's happening? Comment which one.


#ifverse #crush #animation #animatedstory
